Name: Chrysalid Babys
Author: undare
Description:
[color=#c27ba0][size=5][b]Chrysalid Babys![/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]Your farmer and your partner made some questionable life choices and now you have Chrysalid Babys![/size]
[size=3]No need to Overwatch, your New alien babys love you![/size]
[size=3]When they born, they become cocoons, and when they grow they evolve into poisonous chrysalids in need of love and care.[/size]

[size=3]They come in 2 subtle colors...  Slightly blue for males and Slightly purple for females.[/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Install:[/size][/color]
[size=3]This is a XNB Replacer mod.[/size]
[size=3]Make a backup of your files if possible.[/size]


[size=3]Merge "[color=#f1c232]Contents[/color]" folder of this file with your "[color=#ffd966]Contents[/color]" Folder of your SDV Directory.[/size]
[size=3]This mod replaces the vanilla babys with Chryssalids and Chryssalid cocoons from Xcom. (sprited and animated by me from scratch).[/size]

[size=3]This mod replace the xnbs :[/size]
[size=3]Baby[/size]
[size=3]Baby_dark[/size]
[size=3]Toddler[/size]
[size=3]Toddler_dark[/size]
[size=3]Toddler_girl[/size]
[size=3]Toddler_girl_dark


Have fun! and Adopt a Chrysalid today![/size]
